text: This report recommends that City Council approve the proposed demolition of the existing 11-storey building located at 15 Toronto Street in the Saint Lawrence Neighbourhood Heritage Conservation District, and approve the design of a replacement structure, in accordance with Section 42(1) 2 and 42(1) 4 of the Ontario Heritage Act, with conditions. The property is designated under Part 5 of the Ontario Heritage Act as part of the Saint Lawrence Neighbourhood Heritage Conservation District. The subject property is identified as 'non-contributing' in the District Plan. The District Plan allows for the demolition of buildings or structures on a non-contributing property. The proposed new 56-storey mixed-use building complies with the Saint Lawrence Neighbourhood Heritage Conservation District.
